summary: Frontend-only targeted validation completed for GIF button fix in chat composer. Code-path checks confirm GIF button is wired to a real handler and GIF-only validation/upload flow is implemented. Public web preview boots successfully.

integration_issues.flow: Open authenticated chat -> tap GIF button -> pick GIF -> upload/send message
integration_issues.issue: Could not execute end-to-end runtime verification in this run because no authenticated session/credentials were available for chat access.

action_items: Run authenticated device/web smoke test for composer-toolbar-gif tap path on Android and iOS.
Validate picker behavior with both MIME-tagged and extension-only GIF files from common Android providers (Files, Photos, Drive).
critical_code_review_comments: composer-toolbar-gif is no longer hard-disabled and now calls onPickGif via onPress.
onPickGif uses DocumentPicker with GIF intent, validates selected asset via mimeType/name (.gif), uploads as image/gif, and sends through existing image message flow.
No immediate regression seen in adjacent composer toolbar wiring (apps/templates/tools/mic/palette handlers remain intact).
Code quality note: /app/frontend/app/chat/[conversationId].tsx is very large (>700 lines), increasing regression risk and making targeted testing harder.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth-gated chat runtime path remains to be validated with a logged-in account. Static/code-path validation for GIF wiring passed.
rca_of_issue: Original issue was a hard-disabled GIF control with no handler. Current code now defines and wires onPickGif, validates GIF files, and routes through uploadFile + sendMessage(image). Runtime E2E confirmation pending authenticated session. MOCKED APIs: NONE.
